Subjects were profiled from public search snippets so a classifier can tell them from namesakes: Nidhi Hooda is described as the founder of Growpido LLC, based in Dubai, U.A.E. She is presented as a reputation architect who builds executive reputation, strategic influence, and narrative advisory for founders, fund managers, family offices, and CEOs. Growpido is described as a Dubai-based company that builds executive reputation, AI search authority, and brand on LinkedIn. The company is also described as a marketing services firm and a personal branding or reputation advisory agency. Mentions came from web and news searches; LinkedIn results were kept as search engine snippets and never fetched, nothing behind a login was read. Every mention was classified by gpt-5.4-mini; anything not a confident ignore was classified again by gpt-5.6-terra.
